summary: Security fix, update soon with piiShield: up to 0.24.2 an e-mail, IBAN or phone number right after a line break, tab or other JSON-escaped character in a tool result (also result handles, approvals, view context) could reach the model in plain text.
howTo: Nothing to change in code: update. For a result with escapes the detector is called a second time with the strings decoded (a remote detector: two calls); the audit entry lists the extra findings and run time grows with them. What was replaced before still is. Limits: a value only the decoded text found can cut into a pseudonym, so rehydrateArgs then sends an invented value to the backend; a tab column may join a pseudonym; keys and numbers are not pseudonymized.
